requirements.name: google-sign-in
requirements.description: Replaces Google sign-in: the Sign in button opens a picker over the seeded players, and choosing one signs the demo in as that player.

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
requirements.description: OAuth client ID for Google sign-in

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
requirements.description: OAuth client secret for Google sign-in

requirements.name: google-redirect-uri
requirements.description: Redirect URI must be registered before sign-in works
requirements.instructions: Add {{deploy_url}}/auth/google/callback to Authorized redirect URIs for the OAuth client.
